rabbi-yosei-ben-hameshullam.name: Rabbi Yosei ben HaMeshullam
rabbi-yosei-ben-hameshullam.era: Tanna · Land of Israel, late 2nd century
rabbi-yosei-ben-hameshullam.bio: Tanna of the generation of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi.
rabbi-yosei-ben-hameshullam.prompt: A Tanna in his 60s with a long silver beard and a serious, careful expression, one hand resting on a small slaughterer’s blade laid on a cloth; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

achai-beribbi.name: Aḥai Beribbi
achai-beribbi.bio: Sage whose dilemma Rabbi Yoḥanan reports; Rashi calls him a great and distinguished man of his generation.
achai-beribbi.prompt: A distinguished sage in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a thoughtful, questioning look, a finger raised as if posing a problem; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

rav-chananel.name: Rav Ḥananel
rav-chananel.bio: Babylonian Amora, a disciple of Rav who transmitted his teachings.
rav-chananel.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a neat dark beard and a steady, reliable expression, holding a wax tablet of his teacher’s rulings; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rav-chananya-bar-shelamya.name: Rav Ḥananya bar Shelamya
rav-chananya-bar-shelamya.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmitted teachings in the name of Rav.
rav-chananya-bar-shelamya.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a greying brown beard and an earnest expression, one hand open as if reporting a teaching; background of palm groves along the Euphrates.
